title: Retire scaffolding that loses a controlled experiment
narrative: Taloneth starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Taloneth treats an orchestration scaffold as temporary. When a with-versus-without experiment shows the scaffold hurts the primary metric, it is retired so task semantics stay the same without fossil prompts. Accepts inspiration requirement 1[^insp-r01].
implementation: `HarnessExperiment` / `HarnessExperimentRunner` in `mechaharness.harness_experiment` express interventions as hypotheses with expected metrics, compare with/without arms, and list retirement candidates. Integrates with `ResearchLab` for offline evaluation. Trace fields expose experiment id, harness version, and assignment.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.
